reason:
Decided on material version 338915b2 (problem-result-opus-2). The resolution condition has two parts, and only the first is met.

(1) Formal statement: met, as the version itself concedes. The held comparator challenge (489688f5) states the following:
- There is a finite simple host on Fin size, with at least one edge, such that homDensity H host < edgeDensity host ^ 66.
- homCount counts all edge-preserving maps, including noninjective ones.
- edgeDensity is 2e/m^2.
- H is the incidence graph of 22 listed triples on 13 points. I checked the list: it gives 66 incidences and 33 point pairs, each lying in exactly two faces. This matches the manuscript's stated properties of its Table 1 complex.

The config (2d3ce04f) and the scope note (a1da28a9) tie this statement to theorem OAI.SidorenkoCounterexample.main. The scope note says the formalization covers Theorem 1.1 only; the forcing consequence is outside it. So the objection's literal wording, 'not supported by any held source', is partly superseded: held sources do show a formalization that targets the statement.

(2) Axiom and sorry status: not shown.
- The record (0288ac5d) bases sorry status only on a comment-stripped regular-expression search. Its own not_done field says it neither built the project nor ran the comparator, and that 'a textual search is not a kernel check: only a comparator run (or lake build with #print axioms) certifies the proof and its axioms.'
- The 35 solution files are held only as URLs and hashes, so I cannot recheck even the textual audit.
- The repository listing was truncated.
- The permitted_axioms list (propext, Quot.sound, Classical.choice) in 2d3ce04f is a constraint the comparator would enforce if run. It is not an observed axiom set.
- The only build log (55939da0) is the unauthenticated build of the separate girth-six statement file. It contains no #print axioms output and says nothing about the OAI solution module.
- Without a build there is no evidence that the solution even compiles, so the absence of sorry in the source does not establish a sorry-free proof.

The version's fourth point, that the catalogue at that commit does not list the paper, rests on artifact 5a8a1642. Its body was withheld from me, so I did not verify that point, and this disposition does not rely on it.

Conclusion: the objection stands. The Lean formalization cannot serve as an established premise, and the counterexample remains a reported, unverified manuscript result. No correction was requested.
